info.name: DingConnect API
info.description: DingConnect mobile application API. Set base_url to the application origin and token to a Sanctum bearer token. Requests marked NEW cover features added since API baseline e16d8f6efa17fca87d88a334455c2814b717ae89. See API_DOCUMENTATION.md for request details, validation, and response behavior. Every request includes a saved Postman response example showing its success response format; examples use illustrative values, not live data. Latest web parity: bulk retailer SIM limits, a default SIM order limit of 20, and multi-provider SIM comparisons with normalized phone matching. See NEW - SIM Orders and NEW - SIM File Comparisons.

item.name: NEW - SIM File Comparisons
item.description: Admin-only APIs for listing, uploading, and viewing SIM provider-file reconciliation results. Supports multiple selected providers and normalized phone-number/duplicate matching. Requires an active admin Sanctum token.

request.description:
Optional query parameter: page. Returns 15 report summaries per page and operators for the upload form; report_data is omitted from list rows.

Response format: see the saved "Success response format" example under this request.

Send multipart form-data: one or more repeated operator_ids[] fields (existing operator IDs), reconciliation_month (YYYY-MM), and report_file (.xlsx, .xls, .csv, or .txt, max 10 MB). The file requires Provider, Mobile, Serial, and Country headers. Do not manually set Content-Type; Postman supplies the multipart boundary.

Response format: see the saved "Success response format" example under this request.

response.name: Success response format
